name: Kishōtenketsu
description: Four parts from East Asian storytelling, built around a twist rather than a conflict.

beats.name: Introduction
beats.hint: Introduce the characters and their world, calmly.

beats.name: Development
beats.hint: Develop what was introduced, without a major change yet.

beats.name: Twist
beats.hint: An unexpected turn that casts everything before in a new light.

beats.name: Reconciliation
beats.hint: Bring the twist and the first half together into a conclusion.
